projects.title: YARA Malware Detection Rules
projects.description: A collection of YARA rules for identifying and detecting malware patterns using YARA’s rule-based scanning syntax. The repository contains custom `.yar` signatures aimed at improving threat detection and malware analysis workflows.
features: Custom .yar signatures for known malware families
Pattern-based string and byte-sequence matching rules
Structured for use in SOC / EDR detection workflows
